security_state.recovery_backup: EXISTING CGX RECOVERY REFS / HOST-SPECIFIC RESTORE TEST TO VERIFY

suitability.current: Suitable for local filespace/dataspace orchestration, code, moderate CAD/simulation, local inference and review subject to measured workload/thermal limits.
suitability.upgrade_rule: Do not replace hardware because newer parts exist. Measure actual CAD/solver/render/model memory, GPU, thermal, storage and reliability bottlenecks first.
likely_upgrade_triggers: GPU memory/compute constrains required render/solver/local-model workloads
RAM pressure is sustained under representative workloads
storage performance/capacity or reliability becomes a measured blocker
OS/security support or platform security cannot meet the required host policy

compute_placement.C0: Machine safety/control stays on qualified deterministic controllers, not this PC by default.
compute_placement.C1: Local engineering agents/models/tools may run here when explicitly installed and policy-allowed.
compute_placement.C2: External compute is optional, lease-bound, minimum-data and transfers no authority.

maintenance_rule: Supported, authorised, rollback-capable updates only; security/compatibility/readback before and after change.
